authority: Bounded same-run finite-model calculation; no physical or corpus-status admission
chargeDerivation: [H,n_i]=-u_i A_i in implemented finite charge-shell convention; N_i[a,b]=u_i A_i[a,b]/(E_b-E_a), diagonal fixed to zero by inversion
probe: D_x=q_c*a*sum_cell,sum_i (i-3.5)*n_cell,i, with eight sites i=0..7 and local compensating reference at x=0
assumptions: Canonical rotor numbers are assigned physical charge q_c; this is an implementation assumption.
Neglect screening and image-charge changes to the lever arms; Hamiltonian is the supplied effective rotor model.
The charge return is local to each cell and its x-directed dipole contribution vanishes.
No phase-drive transition operator is substituted for the physical charge dipole.
conclusion: The chosen physical-charge dipole does not reproduce O in the eight-root projected model. Dipole response is not converged in retained local roots even though the first gap is stable.
nextTest: Compute physical charge operators with more local roots or bound omitted charge spectral weight; perform electrostatic source/contact matching before physical susceptibility claims.
